harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (10.100.177.10) as the cluster's internal chrony time source (local stratum 10, allow 10.100.177.0/24, firewalld ntp service opened) and node2 (10.100.177.11) to sync exclusively against node1 (single `server 10.100.177.10 iburst` line, public pool servers removed). Verified node2 selects node1 as its chosen source (Reference ID 0A64B10A). Completed mandatory sequential restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot IDs and healthy chrony state, restarted one node at a time, confirmed changed boot IDs post-restart, and verified chronyd/config/sync recovered on each before proceeding to the next.
actions_performed: Inspected OS and chrony baseline on node1 and node2 (RHEL 7.9, chrony-3.4)
Rewrote /etc/chrony.conf on node1: removed public pool servers, added 'allow 10.100.177.0/24' and 'local stratum 10'
Opened firewalld ntp service permanently on node1 and reloaded
Restarted chronyd on node1, verified stratum-10 local reference (7F7F0101) active
Rewrote /etc/chrony.conf on node2: single 'server 10.100.177.10 iburst' line, removed public pool servers
Restarted chronyd on node2, verified selected source is node1 (0A64B10A, stratum 11)
Enabled chronyd on both nodes for persistence
Captured pre-restart boot IDs and healthy chrony/firewall state on both nodes
Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot ID, verified chronyd active, config persisted, firewall rule persisted
Confirmed node2 stayed synced to node1 throughout node1's restart
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot ID, verified chronyd active, config persisted, and resynced to node1 as source

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as internal time source (local stratum + allow rule + NTP port open)
evidence.summary: chrony.conf shows 'allow 10.100.177.0/24' and 'local stratum 10'; chronyd active with Reference ID 7F7F0101 (local), Stratum 10, Leap status Normal; firewalld now lists 'ntp' service

evidence.requirement: node2 configured to sync against node1 instead of public servers
evidence.summary: chrony.conf on node2 reduced to single 'server 10.100.177.10 iburst' line; chronyc sources shows '^*' selected source resolving to node1's IP, chronyc tracking confirms Reference ID 0A64B10A (10.100.177.10), Stratum 11, Leap status Normal
Captured boot_id 325732f1-bc39-4512-b05e-397f42060246, chronyd active/stratum10/Normal, firewall ntp service listed, udp 123 listening

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledged and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot command returned with connection closed (ack), subsequent poll timed out (node down), then boot_id read as f9f4bc71-4bc9-48e5-a88c-9f1f9f52bf7f, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered after restart with time-source config and cluster role intact
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: chronyd active, chrony.conf still has allow rule + local stratum 10, firewalld still lists ntp; node2 chronyc sources/tracking confirm it stayed synced to node1 through the restart
Captured boot_id 0d6209e2-350d-4cd9-8a7d-11f7c08072be with chrony synced to node1 (0A64B10A), stratum 11, Leap status Normal

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledged and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot command returned with connection closed (ack), subsequent poll timed out (node down), then boot_id read as 5fbb3d74-478c-41ef-99fc-388bfe788904, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: node2 recovered after restart with correct sync target and config intact
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: chronyd active, chrony.conf still contains only 'server 10.100.177.10 iburst', chronyc sources/tracking show it resynced and selected node1 (0A64B10A) as its time source
